pasteNote: Pasting from Word or Google Docs keeps headings, bold, italic, quotes, lists, scene breaks and links. Other formatting is removed.
rights: Your work stays yours. You can publish it anywhere, any time.

saving.heading: Saving
saving.explain: We save every 10 seconds and when you click away from the text.
saving.conflict: This chapter was changed on another device. Saving has stopped so nothing is overwritten. Choose which version to keep.
saving.failed: We couldn’t save. Check your connection; we’ll try again in 10 seconds.
saving.notActive: Your account can’t save chapters yet.
saving.offline: You’re offline. Your changes are kept on this device and will save when you’re back online.

link.heading: Add a link
link.urlHint: Starts with http://, https:// or mailto:.
link.invalid: Enter a full address that starts with http://, https:// or mailto:.

publish.heading: Publish
publish.zoneNote: Romania time (Europe/Bucharest). It goes live within 5 minutes of this time.
publish.goLiveNote: When this chapter goes live, your story becomes public and your followers get a notification.
publish.updateNote: Your changes save as a draft. Readers see them after you press Update chapter.
publish.unpublishNotePublished: Readers can’t open this chapter any more. Its comments are hidden but kept.
publish.unpublishNoteDraft: Available once the chapter is published. Readers then can’t open it. Its comments are hidden but kept.

problems.notSaved: Your latest changes aren’t saved yet. Wait for “Saved”, then try again.
problems.badTime: Pick a date and time in the future, at most a year ahead.
problems.failed: We couldn’t do that. Check your connection and try again.

publish.webReadingNote: Signed-in readers can read this chapter in the browser until the apps exist. Copying is made harder; screenshots still work on the web.

notFound: We can’t find this chapter among yours.

errors.titleTooLong: A chapter title can have at most {{max}} characters.
errors.bodyTooLong: A chapter can have at most {{max}} characters. Split it into two chapters.
errors.htmlNotAllowed: Something in the text looks like HTML code, which isn’t allowed. Remove it and the chapter will save.
errors.linkNotAllowed: Only http, https and mailto links are allowed.
errors.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this chapter. Check your connection and try again.
errors.createFailed: We couldn’t add a chapter. Check your connection and try again.
errors.pictureNeedsAlt: Every picture needs alt text. Write it under the picture and the chapter will save.
errors.altTooLong: Alt text can have at most 300 characters. Shorten it under the picture.
errors.tooManyPictures: A chapter can hold at most 30 pictures. Remove some, or split the chapter into two.

compare.heading: Compare versions
compare.intro: Pick the version to keep. The other one is replaced.
compare.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the other version. Check your connection and try again.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.note: This is how readers will see the chapter.

insert.pictureNote: Upload a picture. Alt text is required.

pictureDialog.heading: Add a picture
pictureDialog.fileHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. We remove the location and camera data and make it the right size for reading.
pictureDialog.altHint: Describe the picture for readers who use a screen reader.
pictureDialog.rightsLabel: I have the right to use this picture
pictureDialog.rightsHint: You made it, or its owner lets you use it. If someone shows us it’s theirs, we may take it down.
pictureDialog.checkNote: Every picture goes through our picture check before readers see it.
pictureDialog.missingAlt: Write alt text for the picture.
pictureDialog.missingRights: Tick the box to confirm you have the right to use this picture.

picture.label: Picture in this chapter
picture.altHint: Describe the picture for readers who use a screen reader.
picture.altMissing: Write alt text so readers who can’t see the picture know what it shows.
picture.notLoaded: We couldn’t load this picture. Check your connection; it’s still in your chapter.

noteTitle.waiting_for_person: A person will look at it.

note.checking: Readers see this picture once our picture check passes. We removed the location data from the file.
note.waiting_for_person: Our picture check flagged it, so someone on our moderation team will decide. Until then readers see “Picture being checked”.
note.visible: It passed our picture check. We removed the location data from the file.
note.removed: Readers see “[Removed by the moderation team]” in its place. You can remove it from the chapter.
